takes.line: d|boppy|Gin rummy with Deedee, fifty years. I've never won a hand. Not one. I know a sore loser when I see one.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [deep voice, thick New York accent, rueful] Gin rummy with Deedee, fifty years. [thick New York accent, flat, resigned] I've never won a hand. Not one. [thick New York accent, dry, wry] I know a sore loser when I see one.

takes.line: d|boppy|Sunday. My house. Bring your own deck. You'll lose. I'll lose too. We can lose together.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [deep voice, thick New York accent, warming] Sunday. My house. Bring your own deck. [thick New York accent, dry, flat] You'll lose. I'll lose too. [thick New York accent, kindly, amused] We can lose together.

takes.line: d|tom|Then we'll ask. Nicely. After you give us the mirror.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [gentle, firm] Then we'll ask. Nicely. [dry, warm] After you give us the mirror.

takes.line: d|tom|(Tom doesn't take a picture. Tom takes four pictures.)
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [dry, quiet] (Tom doesn't take a picture. [deadpan, warm] Tom takes four pictures.)

takes.line: d|mudling|Oh. Oh no. People. Don't look at me. I'm just here. With the wall. And this mirror. Which I'm hiding behind.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [panicked, whispering] Oh. Oh no. People. [frantic, small] Don't look at me. I'm just here. [mumbling, tiny] With the wall. And this mirror. Which I'm hiding behind.

takes.line: d|mudling|The Mirrorball. Up in the Dome. She hasn't stopped spinning in three nights.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [hushed, uneasy] The Mirrorball. Up in the Dome. [worried, small] She hasn't stopped spinning in three nights.

takes.line: d|deedee|Honey, there's a whole town walking into hedges down there.
takes.label: new take
takes.script: [gentle, mildly scolding] Honey, there's a whole town walking into hedges down there.
